description: Marche-en-Famenne / Points Wifi - Wifi4eu is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Marche-en-Famenne. Points d'accès gratuits (Intérieur/Extérieur) à Marche-en-Famenne dans le cadre de Wifi4EU. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Urban planning, Heritage. Its keywords are marche-en-famenne, wifi, wifi4eu, omvmef. The portal shows 12 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
